panels.title: 拉取延遲 duration_ms (p95 → 告警 > 60s)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "etl_run" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["source"])

panels.title: 每日 ETL 成功率 (7D，告警 < 95%)

targets.query:
ok = from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "etl_run" and r._field == "count" and r.status == "ok") |> sum()
all = from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "etl_run" and r._field == "count") |> sum()
join(tables: {ok: ok, all: all}, on: ["_start"]) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: float(v: r._value_ok) / float(v: r._value_all) }))

panels.title: 最後一筆資料時間 (now - last > 25h → 告警)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: -2d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "etl_run" and r._field == "last_data_ts")
  |> last()
